subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about paying per completed application instead of per click for {Brand}. The one point worth restating: we run on cost-per-sale, so the payout triggers only on a validated apply that clears your validation window, read through a server-to-server postback that passes click ID and a unique application ID. At scale that has run near 6,000 validated applications a day, deduped on the application ID so one partner is credited per apply. If it helps, I can share the occupation-level validated-apply view. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated completed-application proof
register_notes: Stage 1 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (cost-per-sale on validated completed application, S2S postback with click ID + application ID, dedup on application ID); one illustrative MobUpps figure (6,000 validated applications/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; positives stated directly, no X-not-Y; native US-English register.
